title: Dover AFB - Snow Removal BPA
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR MOBILITY COMMAND > FA4497  436 CONS LGC
description:
THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY  

 The 436th Contracting Squadron is seeking information concerning the availability of small business concern contractors capable of providing the following services. 

  Description of Services -  Snow Removal Services; the contractor shall provide all management, tools, supplies, equipment, expertise and labor necessary to provide snow removal services at Dover Air Force Base (DAFB). Performance shall not be harmful to the traffic surface, as necessary, in order to produce and maintain safe passage of pedestrians and vehicles within identified parking areas. There is approximately 2.7 Million square yards of parking space amongst 8 parking lots on DAFB. The contractor maybe asked to haul snow away airfield surfaces on DAFB if necessary. 

 Please see the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) for a more in depth overview and breakdown of the required services. Please provide current business size standard (e.g. Large or Small Business),  Small business socioeconomic status (if applicable), and applicable NAICS codes. 

  Submit your responses to:  

 Contracting Specialist - A1C Bryce M. Ganske, bryce.ganske@us.af.mil 

 Contracting Officer - TSgt Justin A. Bordalo, justin.bordalo@us.af.mil
